title: The catalog's medium hoodie lands in the cart as a small
observed: Requested HOODIE-001-M ({"color":"black","size":"M"}); cart returned HOODIE-001-S ({"color":"black","size":"S"}). size: required "M", cart has "S".
inferredCause: The cart API maps the medium variant id to the small one before adding the line, so a shopper that orders by catalog id gets the wrong size while a shopper that clicks through the page does not.
suggestedRepair: Remove or correct the legacy variant map in the cart module so HOODIE-001-M resolves to itself.
